color.summary: White pages with #121212 ink, #707070 for secondary text and field edges, #dcdcdc rules. Navy #052962 is the brand: the masthead, the footer and the primary button. Source's blue #0077b6 is for focus, checks, radios and help links; #c1d8fc fills the secondary button; yellow #ffe500 is kept for reader revenue (Support us). Errors are #c70000 and success #22874d. Dark (an opt-in on theguardian.com) turns the article #1a1a1a with #dcdcdc ink and #333333 rules; the sign-in gateway goes black with #999999 field edges.
usage: Articles and fronts take a pillar accent for kickers, bylines and body links: news #c70000, opinion #e05e00, sport #0077b6, culture #866d50, lifestyle #bb3b80.
In dark the masthead and its edition menu stay navy and white.

type.summary: Three proprietary faces. GH Guardian Headline for headlines (500 at 34px on an article, 24px at 700 for container titles), Guardian Text Egyptian for body copy (17px at 400) and Guardian Text Sans for the interface: 17px for buttons and fields, 14px for small controls and table text, 12px for metadata. Buttons are 700.
usage: Times New Roman in the census is unstyled wrapper elements in the Storybooks, not text the reader sees.

shape.summary: Buttons are pills at every size. Fields, selects, checkboxes and summary boxes have 4px corners. Cards on fronts are square, set off by a top rule; the support site's tier cards round to 12px and popovers to 8px.

spacing.summary: A 4px base where 8px and 16px dominate. Buttons are 44px (default), 36px (small) and 24px (xsmall) with 20, 16 and 12px sides. Fields are 44px or 36px with 8px sides.

elevation.summary: Flat: rules and fills do the work and almost nothing casts a shadow. Focus is Source's blue: a 3px #0077b6 halo on links, fields and checks, and a 5px ring on buttons.

button.summary: Source buttons are 700-weight pills in four priorities: primary (navy), secondary (pale blue), tertiary (outlined) and subdued (an underlined text button). Each priority is restyled by theme: brand (on navy), brand alt (on yellow) and reader revenue (yellow). Sizes are default (44px), small (36px) and xsmall (24px, 14px text).
